identity.original_title: Ariokan - create your cards, break the Meta

hooks.text: 内置编辑器组合八个阵营的效果与关键词，生成数百亿种平衡卡牌
hooks.excerpt: With the in-game Cards Editor , you can combine the effects and keywords of 8 different Factions to create balanced cards that make your deck, and strategy, truly unique. With more than 27 billions combinations at your disposal, you'll never run out of options!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 神明为同阵营牌提供被动，完成局内小任务才能召唤传奇单位翻盘
hooks.excerpt: The God is the "leader” of the deck, and provides passive bonuses to all cards of its Faction. Legends are powerful units that you can summon by completing some "mini-quests" during the match, and they can suddenly turn the tides of the battle with their extreme effects.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 回合保持全程互动，可针对对手每次行动即时打牌回应
hooks.excerpt: Cards are auto-balanced (i.e. no "I win" card), and immediately available worldwide to all players that want to unlock them. Also every turn is interactive, and you can play cards as a response to each of your opponent's actions
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 适合厌倦同质卡牌对局的玩家

excerpts.excerpt: Необычный вариант для тех, кому надоели одинаковые карточные баталии
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 主动回合与无冗长连招让对局更有趣

excerpts.excerpt: активные ходы без затянутых комбинаций и возможность самому влиять на мету делают каждую партию интереснее
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
